title: A broken duty and its repair
intro: On day 0 a neighbour asks for your help: you ought to go within two days. A second norm says what you ought to do if you break the first: then you ought at least to call within a day (a contrary-to-duty obligation). A third forbids noise at night. Move the day slider to follow the week and watch each norm become due, kept or broken. Switch the second norm off to see what changes.
ctdLabel: The repair norm is in force (1 = yes)
